_comment: Tickets — self-hosted Discord ticket bot. https://github.com/MCCitiesClone/tickets
name: Tickets
author: evan.dayton.sizemore@gmail.com
description: Tickets — a self-hosted Discord ticket bot with panels, forms, transcripts, canned responses and a web dashboard. This egg runs the BOT process only; it needs an external PostgreSQL database, and the web dashboard is hosted separately (both point at the same DATABASE_URL). Migrations are applied automatically on start.
startup: npm run db:migrate:run && npm run bot

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Tickets — Pterodactyl/Pelican installation script.
#
# Clones (or updates) the bot's source into the server directory and installs
# dependencies. Runs in a throwaway Node container; /mnt/server becomes
# /home/container at runtime.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/MCCitiesClone/tickets.git}"
REF="${GIT_REF:-main}"

# Idempotent: a re-install updates in place instead of failing on a non-empty
# directory, so server files (and the archived attachments below) survive.
if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Updating existing checkout to ${REF}…"
    git remote set-url origin "${REPO}"
else
    echo "Cloning ${REPO} (${REF})…"
    git init -q .
    git remote add origin "${REPO}"
fi

git fetch --depth 1 origin "${REF}"
git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
# Keep installed dependencies, archived attachments, and any local .env the
# operator added — a reinstall should update the code, not wipe the server.
git clean -fd -e node_modules -e .data -e .env

echo "Installing dependencies…"
# Dev dependencies included on purpose: the bot runs TypeScript directly with
# tsx, exactly like the project's Docker `bot` image.
npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund

echo ""
echo "Tickets installed."
echo "Point DATABASE_URL at a PostgreSQL server before starting — the bot"
echo "applies its own migrations on boot."

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string, e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/tickets. The bot applies migrations here on every start. The web dashboard must use the SAME database.

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot -> Reset Token). Enable the MESSAGE CONTENT intent on that page — transcripts need it.

variables.name: Discord client ID
variables.description: Application (client) ID from the Discord Developer Portal. Used to register slash commands.

variables.name: Discord client secret
variables.description: OAuth2 client secret. The bot doesn't sign anyone in, but it shares one config schema with the dashboard, so it must be set.

variables.name: Auth secret
variables.description: Random 32+ character string, shared with the dashboard. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Dashboard URL
variables.description: Public URL of the web dashboard. Used to build the transcript links the bot posts.

variables.name: Dev guild ID
variables.description: Optional. Register slash commands to this one server for instant updates while testing. Leave empty to register globally (Discord can take up to an hour to propagate).

variables.name: Attachment archive directory
variables.description: Where ticket attachments are copied off Discord's expiring CDN. Relative paths resolve inside the server directory. The dashboard must be able to read this same path to serve them.

variables.name: Archive attachments
variables.description: Set to false to skip archiving and keep the original (expiring) Discord CDN URLs in transcripts.

variables.name: Max attachment size (bytes)
variables.description: Attachments larger than this are not archived. Default 26214400 (25 MiB).

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Source repository cloned at install. Change it to run a fork.

variables.name: Git ref
variables.description: Branch or tag installed. Reinstall the server to move to a different ref.
